<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Error - The Australian Financial Review</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="/views/assets/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon" />
  <style>
  @font-face {
    font-family: sueca_hd_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: normal;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: sueca_hd_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: bold;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: suecanano_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: normal;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: suecanano_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: bold;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  body,
  button,
  h1,
  h2,
  h3,
  h5,
  p,
  ul,
  ol,
  li {
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
  }

  * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    word-wrap: break-word;
  }

  body {
    font-family: sueca_hd_regular, Georgia, Times, serif;
  }

  .header {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: 64px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 4px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
  }

  .header__logo {
    width: 200px;
    height: 34px;
    fill: #1976d2;
  }

  .wrapper {
    display: flex;
    height: calc(100vh - 64px);
    height: -webkit-calc(100vh - 64px);
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .content {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1260px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    padding: 32px 16px 80px;
    margin-right: auto;
    margin-left: auto;
  }

  .content__dash {
    width: 32px;
    margin-right: 8px;
  }

  .content__error-code {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 48px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-family: suecanano_regular, Arial, Lucida Grande, sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .content__error-code::before {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 0;
    width: 32px;
    height: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid #172933;
    content: '';
  }

  .content__error-message {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-size: 40px;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .content__error-explanation {
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .content__success {
    color: #1976d2;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .content__contact-us {
    color: #1976d2;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .content__success:hover, .content__contact-us:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .content__home-button {
    display: block;
    width: 170px;
    height: 32px;
    padding: 8px 0;
    background-color: #1976d2;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: suecanano_regular, Arial, Lucida Grande, sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    line-height: 1.3;
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease-in-out;
  }

  .content__home-button:hover {
    background-color: #0d3960;
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 768px) {
    .content {
      padding: 64px 88px 112px;
    }

    .content__error-code {
      padding-left: 0;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .content__error-code::before {
      left: -56px;
    }

    .content__error-message {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-size: 54px;
    }

    .content__error-explanation {
      font-size: 18px;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 1020px) {
    .header {
      height: 82px;
    }

    .header__logo {
      width: 300px;
    }

    .wrapper {
      height: calc(100vh - 82px);
      height: -webkit-calc(100vh - 82px);
    }

    .content {
      padding: 64px 102px 112px;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 1180px) {
    .content {
      padding-right: 56px;
      padding-left: 56px;
    }

    .content__error-wrapper {
      margin-right: 40px;
      margin-left: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 120px;
    }

    .content__error-code {
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .content__error-message {
      font-size: 90px;
    }
  }

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Error - The Australian Financial Review</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="/views/assets/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon" />
  <style>
  @font-face {
    font-family: sueca_hd_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: normal;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: sueca_hd_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: bold;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: suecanano_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: normal;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: suecanano_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: bold;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  body,
  button,
  h1,
  h2,
  h3,
  h5,
  p,
  ul,
  ol,
  li {
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
  }

  * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    word-wrap: break-word;
  }

  body {
    font-family: sueca_hd_regular, Georgia, Times, serif;
  }

  .header {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: 64px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 4px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
  }

  .header__logo {
    width: 200px;
    height: 34px;
    fill: #1976d2;
  }

  .wrapper {
    display: flex;
    height: calc(100vh - 64px);
    height: -webkit-calc(100vh - 64px);
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .content {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1260px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    padding: 32px 16px 80px;
    margin-right: auto;
    margin-left: auto;
  }

  .content__dash {
    width: 32px;
    margin-right: 8px;
  }

  .content__error-code {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 48px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-family: suecanano_regular, Arial, Lucida Grande, sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .content__error-code::before {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 0;
    width: 32px;
    height: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid #172933;
    content: '';
  }

  .content__error-message {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-size: 40px;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .content__error-explanation {
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .content__success {
    color: #1976d2;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .content__contact-us {
    color: #1976d2;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .content__success:hover, .content__contact-us:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .content__home-button {
    display: block;
    width: 170px;
    height: 32px;
    padding: 8px 0;
    background-color: #1976d2;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: suecanano_regular, Arial, Lucida Grande, sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    line-height: 1.3;
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease-in-out;
  }

  .content__home-button:hover {
    background-color: #0d3960;
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 768px) {
    .content {
      padding: 64px 88px 112px;
    }

    .content__error-code {
      padding-left: 0;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .content__error-code::before {
      left: -56px;
    }

    .content__error-message {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-size: 54px;
    }

    .content__error-explanation {
      font-size: 18px;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 1020px) {
    .header {
      height: 82px;
    }

    .header__logo {
      width: 300px;
    }

    .wrapper {
      height: calc(100vh - 82px);
      height: -webkit-calc(100vh - 82px);
    }

    .content {
      padding: 64px 102px 112px;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 1180px) {
    .content {
      padding-right: 56px;
      padding-left: 56px;
    }

    .content__error-wrapper {
      margin-right: 40px;
      margin-left: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 120px;
    }

    .content__error-code {
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .content__error-message {
      font-size: 90px;
    }
  }

  .FooterSocial-item:not(:first-child) {
    margin-left: 16px;
  }

  .FooterSocial-link {
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: suecanano_regular, arial, lucida grande, sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    line-height: 1rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s ease-in-out, background-color 0.2s ease-in-out, border-color 0.2s ease-in-out;
    font-weight: bold;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    background-color: transparent;
    color: #fff;
    display: block;
    padding: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .FooterSocial-link:hover, .FooterSocial-link:focus {
    border-color: #03345d;
    background-color: #03345d;
    outline: 0;
  }
  @media (min-width: 768px) {
    .FooterSocial-link {
      padding: 12px;
    }
  }

  .FooterSocial-list {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    list-style: none;
  }
  @media (min-width: 768px) {
    .FooterSocial-list {

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Error - The Australian Financial Review</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="/views/assets/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon" />
  <style>
  @font-face {
    font-family: sueca_hd_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: normal;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: sueca_hd_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: bold;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: suecanano_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: normal;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: suecanano_regular;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: bold;
    src: url('data:application/font-woff2;base64,');
  }

  body,
  button,
  h1,
  h2,
  h3,
  h5,
  p,
  ul,
  ol,
  li {
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
  }

  * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    word-wrap: break-word;
  }

  body {
    font-family: sueca_hd_regular, Georgia, Times, serif;
  }

  .header {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: 64px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 4px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
  }

  .header__logo {
    width: 200px;
    height: 34px;
    fill: #1976d2;
  }

  .wrapper {
    display: flex;
    height: calc(100vh - 64px);
    height: -webkit-calc(100vh - 64px);
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .content {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1260px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    padding: 32px 16px 80px;
    margin-right: auto;
    margin-left: auto;
  }

  .content__dash {
    width: 32px;
    margin-right: 8px;
  }

  .content__error-code {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 48px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-family: suecanano_regular, Arial, Lucida Grande, sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .content__error-code::before {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 0;
    width: 32px;
    height: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid #172933;
    content: '';
  }

  .content__error-message {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-size: 40px;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .content__error-explanation {
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .content__success {
    color: #1976d2;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .content__contact-us {
    color: #1976d2;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .content__success:hover, .content__contact-us:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .content__home-button {
    display: block;
    width: 170px;
    height: 32px;
    padding: 8px 0;
    background-color: #1976d2;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: suecanano_regular, Arial, Lucida Grande, sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    line-height: 1.3;
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease-in-out;
  }

  .content__home-button:hover {
    background-color: #0d3960;
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 768px) {
    .content {
      padding: 64px 88px 112px;
    }

    .content__error-code {
      padding-left: 0;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .content__error-code::before {
      left: -56px;
    }

    .content__error-message {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-size: 54px;
    }

    .content__error-explanation {
      font-size: 18px;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 1020px) {
    .header {
      height: 82px;
    }

    .header__logo {
      width: 300px;
    }

    .wrapper {
      height: calc(100vh - 82px);
      height: -webkit-calc(100vh - 82px);
    }

    .content {
      padding: 64px 102px 112px;
    }
  }

  @media screen and (min-width: 1180px) {
    .content {
      padding-right: 56px;
      padding-left: 56px;
    }

    .content__error-wrapper {
      margin-right: 40px;
      margin-left: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 120px;
